text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a small docs PR to localize the 'audit evidence' wording for EU/ES and APAC markets. Need legal-approved translations for SOC2 phrasing and the example export snippets in Spanish/Japanese.
jake: thanks. do we have canonical legal text to translate or should we create a simple, non-lawyered version for docs? @legal will need to sign off either way.
li: I can prep the SDK snippet variants. quick Q: do we want i18n keys (e.g. audit.evidence.heading) or separate markdown files per locale?
sam: prefer i18n keys so we keep single source of truth. translations live in /i18n/<locale>/docs.json.
maria: agree w/ sam. i'll add keys and stash the English copy in the PR. legal can provide the final translations to drop into the locale files.
jake: security note — ensure we don't accidentally change examples that imply longer retention than policy. keep TTL examples generic (e.g. "retention: 90 days") and link to the retention policy page.
li: working on code snippets. here's a draft for the Spanish docs page:

```curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"t-123","since":"2025-01-01","format":"jsonl"}'
```

and python:

```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = c.audit.export(tenant_id="t-123", since="2025-01-01", format="jsonl")
```

li: I'll add comments above snippets to say "Ejemplo" / "例" as appropriate.
oliver: PR number? want to allocate review bandwidth.
maria: opened as PR #4589 — title: "i18n: audit evidence wording + localized SDK snippets (es, ja)". links in thread: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4589
doc-bot: docs build queued for PR #4589. status: pending.
sam: I'll queue a docs reviewer (oliver) and ping legal for translation. @jake can you confirm the retention phrasing?
jake: Confirmed — keep phrasing to: "We retain audit export evidence for up to 90 days unless subject to legal hold". legal / policy team to confirm exact locale translations.
maria: Action items: (1) legal to provide translated lines for 3 i18n keys, (2) li to add localized snippets and labels, (3) docs team to run linkcheck and spellcheck. I'll update PR description with checklist.
li: ETA for snippets: EOD today.
oliver: I'll review tomorrow morning — priority: phrasing + link correctness.
maria: thx everyone. if legal signs off faster, we'll merge and trigger a patch release of the docs site. :thumbsup:
doc-bot: docs build for PR #4589 passed ✅ — staging deployed: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/i18n/es/audit-evidence
maria: staging looks good, but legal still needs to confirm Spanish nuance on "evidence" vs "registro". pinging legal now.
